title: Malaysian National MY Core v2 Implementation Guide
introduction: National baseline FHIR R4 implementation guide for Malaysia. The current release, MY Core v2.1.1, is published for trial use; artefact identifiers are under the standards.moh.gov.my publication model.

list.desc: Canonical re-cut of the three use case release. Identical scope to 2.1.0 -- ADT notes, laboratory reports, radiology reports and the Malaysian Pathology Catalogue -- with every artefact identifier moved to the standards.moh.gov.my namespace, and terminology and profiles now published from TermX.

WITHDRAWN. Superseded by 2.1.1. The canonical base in 2.1.0 was https://myehr.kkmhub.moh.gov.my/fhir/my-core; every artefact identifier moved to https://standards.moh.gov.my/fhir/my-core in 2.1.1. Do not implement against 2.1.0.
Initial MY Core v2 draft release
